name: Graphite
summary: Code review platform for GitHub with stacked PRs, AI review and a merge queue.
description: Graphite is a code review platform for teams on GitHub. It supports stacked pull requests through its CLI and web app, provides AI reviews, a merge queue and insights. Cursor Cloud Agents are now integrated so users can create and ship changes from a pull request. A Hobby plan is free for personal repositories; Starter costs $20 and Team $40 per user per month, billed annually.
